children: An affable personality, a strong belief in delegation, high emotional intelligence, and excellent communication skills are traits that could help ICICI Group veteran Anup Bagchi steer the affairs of HDFC Bank, India’s largest private sector lender, as its next MD & CEO.

Market participants believe Bagchi, currently MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, is likely to emphasise his trust in HDFC Bank’s existing leadership team and work with them to take the franchise to even greater heights.

Bagchi understands the importance of continuity, having spent nearly 34 years within the ICICI Group. As a result, he is unlikely to arrive as a transformative outsider seeking to install his own team and disrupt the established order at HDFC Bank.
People who have worked with him describe his leadership style as unobtrusive. He is known to avoid micromanaging operations, instead focusing on the broader strategic picture.

“Bagchi does not believe in sitting in his office and summoning colleagues for discussions. Instead, he prefers informal conversations over a cup of coffee in the cafeteria, discussing important matters without relying on PowerPoint presentations or Excel sheets. He has a sharp memory and maintains strong eye contact during interactions,” his former colleagues said.
Away from work, Bagchi prefers unwinding with a mug of black coffee and a non-fiction book from which he can draw lessons and insights.

Bagchi will become only the third chief executive in HDFC Bank’s 32-year history. Aditya Puri served the longest tenure, leading the bank for 26 years, while outgoing MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan has held the position for six years.

The incoming chief executive holds a management degree from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore and an engineering degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur. He has been appointed for a three-year term beginning October 27, 2026.
The bank’s board has also approved Bagchi’s appointment as an Additional Director with effect from October 2, 2026, subject to shareholders’ approval.

Over the course of his career, Bagchi has held several key leadership roles, including MD & CEO of ICICI Securities, Executive Director at ICICI Bank from 2017 to 2023, and, most recently, MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance..

title: A consensus builder who unwinds with black coffee and a non-fiction book
